sources.title: Bombay High Court: Patkar bail, 2025:BHC-AS:29188
sources.publisher: Bombay High Court judgment transcribed by Indian Kanoon
sources.locator: BA 3/2025; §6 invoice/penalty/TDS figures, §§15–21 and 28–35 defence, §§39–54 parity and conditional bail
